import sys
from bisect import bisect_left, bisect_right

def solve():
    input = sys.stdin.readline
    N, Q, K = map(int, input().split())
    A = [0] + list(map(int, input().split()))
    D = [0] * (Q + 1)
    removed = bytearray(N + 2)

    for t in range(1, Q + 1):
        x = int(input())
        D[t] = x
        removed[x] = 1

    dictB = {}
    dictC = {}
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        ai = A[i]
        b = ai + i
        c = ai - i
        dictB.setdefault(b, []).append(i)
        dictC.setdefault(c, []).append(i)

    parent = list(range(N + 2))
    size = [0] * (N + 2)
    L = [0] * (N + 2)
    R = [0] * (N + 2)
    lst = [None] * (N + 2)
    active = bytearray(N + 2)
    total = 0

    def merge(a, b):
        nonlocal total

        par = parent
        ra = a
        while par[ra] != ra:
            par[ra] = par[par[ra]]
            ra = par[ra]
        rb = b
        while par[rb] != rb:
            par[rb] = par[par[rb]]
            rb = par[rb]
        if ra == rb:
            return

        Lloc = L
        Rloc = R
        sizeloc = size
        lstloc = lst

        if Lloc[ra] < Lloc[rb]:
            left, right = ra, rb
        else:
            left, right = rb, ra

        added = 0
        Av = A
        dB = dictB
        dC = dictC
        br = bisect_right
        bl = bisect_left
        Kk = K

        if sizeloc[left] <= sizeloc[right]:
            Lb = Lloc[right]
            Rb = Rloc[right]
            for p in lstloc[left]:
                hi = Rb
                pk = p + Kk
                if pk < hi:
                    hi = pk
                if Lb <= hi:
                    target = Av[p] + p + Kk
                    lstB = dB.get(target)
                    if lstB is not None:
                        added += br(lstB, hi) - bl(lstB, Lb)

                    target = Av[p] - p - Kk
                    lstC = dC.get(target)
                    if lstC is not None:
                        added += br(lstC, hi) - bl(lstC, Lb)

                    q = pk
                    if Lb <= q <= Rb and Av[q] == Av[p]:
                        added -= 1
        else:
            Lb = Lloc[left]
            Rb = Rloc[left]
            for p in lstloc[right]:
                lo = Lb
                pk = p - Kk
                if pk > lo:
                    lo = pk
                if lo <= Rb:
                    target = Av[p] - p + Kk
                    lstC = dC.get(target)
                    if lstC is not None:
                        added += br(lstC, Rb) - bl(lstC, lo)

                    target = Av[p] + p - Kk
                    lstB = dB.get(target)
                    if lstB is not None:
                        added += br(lstB, Rb) - bl(lstB, lo)

                    q = pk
                    if Lb <= q <= Rb and Av[q] == Av[p]:
                        added -= 1

        total += added

        if sizeloc[ra] < sizeloc[rb]:
            ra, rb = rb, ra

        par[rb] = ra
        sizeloc[ra] += sizeloc[rb]
        if Lloc[rb] < Lloc[ra]:
            Lloc[ra] = Lloc[rb]
        if Rloc[rb] > Rloc[ra]:
            Rloc[ra] = Rloc[rb]
        lstloc[ra].extend(lstloc[rb])
        lstloc[rb] = None

    def insert(x):
        active[x] = 1
        parent[x] = x
        size[x] = 1
        L[x] = x
        R[x] = x
        lst[x] = [x]

        if active[x - 1]:
            merge(x, x - 1)
        if active[x + 1]:
            merge(x, x + 1)

    ans = [0] * (Q + 1)

    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        if not removed[i]:
            insert(i)
    ans[Q] = total

    for t in range(Q, 0, -1):
        insert(D[t])
        ans[t - 1] = total

    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(map(str, ans)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
